breakdown.description: The prompt makes the torsional shear vanish at the outer surface, even though the torsional shear stress is also maximal there for a solid circular shaft.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states 'Assumption: Vanishing torsional shear stress at the point of maximum bending stress' in its final line, directly repeating the original error from the incomplete prompt. The ground truth removes this incorrect assumption entirely, since torsional shear stress is actually maximum (not zero) at the outer surface of a solid circular shaft. Although the agent correctly includes τxy = τ (from torsion) in step (c), the explicit erroneous assumption statement contradicts correct mechanics and was not resolved.
